title: Thelma back in New York and the offer to sell pianos
summary: Hodes's wife returned and kept him going. Hodes says the offer to sell pianos came when music was bad, and she told him not to do it.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And -- yeah, she came back. She decided three months was enough, doing this and that. Somehow she'll build a fire under me and we'll do it together. And of course that's been the story of my life with her because she has, one way or another. (Inaudible.) There was a time when music was so bad I wanted to get out and sell pianos because I had an offer.
And she says, don't do it. Music has been too good to us. Don't do it.

Yeah, and it got very -- well, you know how this business can get, very horrible. Til you have no work, or distressing jobs. And if you can't do anything, if you can't do anything, then you're in trouble.
